Claude.analysis:
24-Hour Summary (June 17-18, 2026)

Several notable incidents detected, with significant activity in East Palo Alto early morning of June 18.

  • Armed Subjects with Firearms (Jun 18, ~7:15 AM, 1640 Bay Road area)
    Hispanic male, 18-20 years old, shoulder-length hair, black sweater/black pants observed carrying 2 firearms (one black handgun, one gold-plated). Ran through parking lot toward Bay Road. Later reports indicated a female and 2 additional males (18-25 years old, dressed in black) may be associated. Vehicle occupied by 3 stopped at Chevron for search. Case 1723 — Most serious safety concern.
  • Vehicle Pursuit with Suspected Stolen Car (Jun 18, ~4:08-4:12 AM, EPA area)
    White Lexus with no license plates, 2 occupants in all black with hoodies. Officers detected as possible 10851 (vehicle theft). Vehicle fled toward 101 southbound at high speed (~110 mph). CHP took over pursuit. Involves area near Chevron and University.
  • Assault/Battery with Vehicle Flight (Jun 17, 6:39-7:02 PM, 1221 Willow Red)
    Hispanic male, ~250 lbs, colorful shirt with suspenders, punched RP. RP countered. Suspect fled in older pickup truck (possibly light yellow, 1990s model, wood on sides). Suspect may have broken leg/sustained injuries.
  • Suspicious Incident / Possible False Report (Jun 18, 2:13-2:31 AM, 1805 East Bay Shore, Light Tree Apartment)
    Initial report of machete/knives and active fight, multiple subjects. Subsequent reports contradictory—occupants claimed no fight occurred. RP became uncooperative/evasive. Resolved as non-responsive to police, no actual incident confirmed.
  • Burglary / Suspicious Incident (Jun 17, 9:30-10:47 PM, 1071 Sierra Drive)
    Shattered back sliding window discovered. Changed to suspicious circumstances (no clear evidence of entry).
  • Minor Robbery (Jun 17, 7:51 PM, 2612 Zandaza Street, EPA)
    Juvenile (approximately 10 years old) took squishy toy ($20) and fled on gray bicycle.

Key Concern: Armed subjects in EPA early morning with firearms and potential associates. Recommend heightened alert in Berkeley Ave / Coleman Ave / Bay Road corridor.

Gemini.analysis:
Major Incidents & Weapons

  • High-Speed Pursuit & Stolen Vehicle (East Palo Alto): Officers engaged in a pursuit of a suspected stolen white Lexus with no license plates. Two males wearing black hoodies bailed out of the car at a Chevron (Euclid & East Bayshore). The vehicle then fled onto 101 South at speeds up to 110 mph before CHP took over.
  • Armed Suspect (East Palo Alto): Police responded to 1640 Bay Road for an 18-20 year old Hispanic male carrying two firearms (one black, one gold) fleeing through a parking lot. A suspect vehicle (Mercedes) with matching occupants was later detained at the Chevron on University & Donahoe.
  • Weapon Disturbances: Dispatch received an unconfirmed report of a large fight involving a machete at 1805 East Bayshore. In a separate incident, a male in his 30s was reported swinging a sword at the corner of California and Santla.

Break-Ins, Thefts & Local Incidents

  • Battery near Coleman Ave (Menlo Park): Officers responded to a physical altercation at 15 Coleman Place. The suspect reportedly assaulted the caller, damaged their phone, and fled in an older, faded-yellow pickup truck with wooden sides, last seen heading Westbound on Willow Road.
  • Residential Break-In (Menlo Park): A smashed rear sliding glass window was reported at a residence on 1071 Sierra Drive. The break-in was discovered by a cleaning lady while the homeowners were out of town.
  • E-Bike Theft (East Palo Alto): An electric bicycle was reported stolen overnight from an apartment complex at 1735 Woodland Avenue.
  • Strong-Arm Theft (East Palo Alto): A juvenile on a gray bicycle snatched an item an individual was attempting to sell at 2612 Zandaza Street and fled toward Illinois Street.

Suspicious Activity & Prowlers

  • Repeated Suspicious Person (Atherton): A resident at 199 Oak Grove reported that a subject had been repeatedly appearing at their gate over several days, claiming to be trying to deliver a package.
  • Suspicious Drone (Atherton): A resident at 1045 Cadillac reported a drone hovering outside their window, shining a light directly through their blackout curtains.
  • Suspicious Person (Menlo Park): Units checked the North lot area near the Menlo Park Library early in the morning for reports of a man screaming.

scores.reason: Analysis fabricates major violent incidents (armed suspects, high-speed pursuit, machete/sword attacks) entirely absent from transcripts; transcripts contain only routine vehicle registration checks and heavily garbled dispatch chatter.
